name: io.github.bzsasson/screaming-frog-mcp
title: Screaming Frog SEO Spider MCP Server (headless)
description: Headless control of Screaming Frog SEO Spider via its CLI: run crawls, export and filter crawl data, manage crawl storage. No GUI session required, unlike the official in-app MCP.

environmentVariables.name: SF_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Screaming Frog SEO Spider CLI executable. Defaults to the standard macOS location.
